name: memo-cook
description: Explicit, traceable, Markdown-backed memory outboard for Codex and other agents.

interface.shortDescription: Save and retrieve explicit, traceable agent memories
interface.longDescription: MemoCook gives Codex a shared long-term memory outboard backed by Markdown notes and a rebuildable SQLite FTS index. It only writes memory when the user explicitly asks to save, remember, capture, organize, or link something.
defaultPrompt: Search or save explicit memories with MemoCook
